rules.statement: A fiduciary is entitled to compensation for improvements and can retain the property until such compensation is paid, even if the fidei commissarii are not yet in esse.
rules.supporting_quote: It was also submitted that the decision had not the binding authority of a Full Court decision. As the appellant�s Counsel appeared to question 371 the correctness of the statement of the Editor of the Law Reports that it was the judgment of Clarence J. and Bias J. that was delivered by Clarence J., I examined the original judgments kept at the Supreme Court Registry and found that the statement in the Law Reports was correct as the judgment delivered by Clarence J. had been signed both by Clarence J. and Bias J. while a separate dissenting judgment was given by Burnside C.J.
